validatorDefects.detail: The root draft of scripts/qc/validate-openspec-ci-quality.mjs applied unmodified and needed no correction. Checked by hand: (a) it imports all five data exports from openspec-ci-contracts.mjs and both functions from openspec-workflow-contracts.mjs; (b) it deletes the four now-duplicated local tables and the two regex helpers workflowJobBlock and parseAggregatorNeeds with no remaining references; (c) aggregator needs are read from the parsed YAML job rather than a needs: [ ... ] regex, with a scalar-needs normalisation branch the regex form did not have; (d) workflowJobContracts is surfaced in both the --json manifest and the human summary line; (e) the yaml runtime dependency the new module needs is already a resolved devDependency at 2.9.0, merged with the contract modules in #1647.
observations: The wiring changes the validator from substring matching to parsed-YAML job scoping only for requiredWorkflowJobContracts; requiredWorkflowTokens keeps its loose whole-file matching by design, as the contract module comment states.

parseWorkflowJobs pushes workflow-yaml-invalid and returns an empty jobs map on a parse failure, so a malformed pr-checks.yml surfaces as an explicit error rather than a silent pass. Confirmed by reading the module; not separately probed this session.
Before this prefix the two contract modules were dead code on main: the ci-module-independent-review-20260912.json finding moduleWiringAbsent is now closed by commit b3077f197.
